chunks: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, He is the giver of life and death, and He has power over everything.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is the giver of life and death?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's absolute dominion (Mulku) over the heavens and earth, serving as a foundation for His authority in both creation and resurrection. It highlights the divine attribute of Qudrah (Omnipotence), affirming that life and death are solely under His command, a concept often linked to the Imamate's role in manifesting divine will on earth.
